summary: Invalid characters crash the game in jigsaw block input upon pressing enter
description: The bug Invalid characters crash the game in jigsaw block input upon pressing enter. How to reproduce - Execute the command: /give @s jigsaw - Open the jigsaw block (displaying the user interface) - Type in any of the text boxes, characters: or {} (invalid unicode characters blocking the "done" button) - Press the enter key The game crashes Crash report 1.14.3-pre3 : [^crash-2019-06-16_22.54.27-client.txt] Description: keyPressed event handler n: Non [a-z0-9/._-] character in path of location: minecraft:empty at qt. (SourceFile:38) at qt. (SourceFile:43) at dbo.d(SourceFile:44) at dbo.b(SourceFile:35) at dbo.keyPressed(SourceFile:106) at cvm.a(SourceFile:410) at cvm$$Lambda$3043/1332786777.run(Unknown Source) at czx.wrapScreenError(SourceFile:441) at cvm.a(SourceFile:408) at cvm$$Lambda$1477/601932288.invoke(Unknown Source) at org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFWKeyCallbackI.callback(GLFWKeyCallbackI.java:37) at org.lwjgl.system.JNI.invokeV(Native Method) at org.lwjgl.glfw.GLFW.glfwPollEvents(GLFW.java:3101) at cuh.l(SourceFile:425) at cuh.c(SourceFile:283) at cvo.b(SourceFile:1023) at cvo.e(SourceFile:976) at cvo.b(SourceFile:411) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:154)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft Java Edition.
2. Execute the command: `/give @s jigsaw`.
3. Open the jigsaw block (displaying the user interface).
4. Type in any of the text boxes the characters: `:` or `{}` (invalid unicode characters).
5. Press the enter key.
6. Observe that the game crashes.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.14.2, 1.14.3 Pre-Release 3, 1.14.3 Pre-Release 4, 1.14.3
Observed Behavior: The issue occurs when invalid characters are entered into the jigsaw block input interface, specifically when characters such as colons or curly braces are typed into any of the text boxes. To reproduce the bug, players should execute the command /give @s jigsaw, then open the jigsaw block interface and attempt to input these invalid characters. Upon pressing the enter key after entering these characters, the game crashes. The crash report for version 1.14.3-pre3 indicates a failure in the keyPressed event handler, highlighting a non-alphanumeric character in the path of location minecraft:empty. The crash log shows that the error originates from the event handling system, which fails to process the input correctly, leading to a complete game crash. This behavior suggests that the jigsaw block input does not adequately validate user input, allowing invalid characters to cause instability in the game.
Expected Behavior: When entering valid characters into the jigsaw block input and pressing the enter key, the game should successfully process the input without crashing. The jigsaw block interface should allow users to input a variety of valid characters, enabling them to create and configure custom structures seamlessly. The "done" button should remain accessible, allowing players to finalize their input without encountering any errors or crashes.
